# split .profile and move functions outside

Break the monolithic `.profile` into files under `bin/`, one per concern, so that each function can be executed and unit-tested on its own; `lookup` is the proof of concept, and the moved functions are to be covered by bats tests ([[DOT-153]]).

<!-- 2022-02-20T20:29Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/156#issuecomment-1046314876
https://www.bashsupport.com/manual/navigation/libraries/
-->

<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/156#issuecomment-5711682659
Code vs intent: the bats suites test copies (`test/lookup.bash`, `test/lookup.zsh`, an inline `datetime` in `test/datetime.bats`), not the library functions, so the "cover them by unit tests" goal is not met even for the PoC; `lookup.bats` also asserts `git_commit`, `git_aliases`, `m`/`mm` aliases and a `bin/explain` script that no longer exist.
